description: Before neblla_create_app: given the `decisions` known so far (kind, players, modules…), returns those still pending, each with `how_to_infer` and `ask_user`. When `have_enough_context` is true, pass the returned `decisions` to neblla_create_app. Only for new apps; changes nothing. More: neblla_get_llms tools/validate_requirements

decisions.description: Answered so far, by decision id, e.g. { kind: "game", players: "multi" }.
